ocl:
context Cluster
inv: (self.gateways->exists(x | x.isPrimary = true)) and (self.name <> '' and self.name.size() > 0)

context AlertRule
inv: (self.alerts->exists(x | x.acknowledged = true)) and (self.alerts->size() <= 1)

context DataStream
inv: self.alertRules->any(x | x.ruleId <> '') <> null

context DataStream
inv: self.records->any(x | x.timestamp <> '') <> null

context ActuatorNode
inv: self.maxLoad >= 17 and self.maxLoad <= 83

context Battery
inv: self.healthPct >= 46 and self.healthPct <= 55

context Location
inv: self.longitude >= 24 and self.longitude <= 38

context APIKey
inv: (self.createdAt <> null) and (self.user <> null)

context ConnectivityModule
inv: (self.links->any(x | x.bandwidthKbps > 1) <> null) and (self.links->notEmpty())

context Gateway
inv: (self.cluster <> null) and (not(self.cluster <> null))

context Metric
inv: ((self.sensor.sampleRateHz < 10) and (self.name.size() = 17)) and (not((self.sensor.sampleRateHz < 10) and (self.name.size() = 17)))

context CommunicationLink
inv: (self.bandwidthKbps mod 3 = 0) and (not(self.bandwidthKbps mod 3 = 0))

context EdgeNode
inv: ((self.gateway.isPrimary) and (self.cpuCores mod 6 = 0)) and (not((self.gateway.isPrimary) and (self.cpuCores mod 6 = 0)))

context AccessPolicy
inv: ((self.roles->notEmpty()) and (self.description.size() >= 2)) and (not((self.roles->notEmpty()) and (self.description.size() >= 2)))

context Battery
inv: (self.healthPct mod 2 = 1) and (not(self.healthPct mod 2 = 1))

context EdgeNode
inv: ((self.gateway.isPrimary) and (self.gateway <> null)) and (not((self.gateway.isPrimary) and (self.gateway <> null)))

context Network
inv: (self.links->select(x | x.bandwidthKbps >= 1)->size() >= 1) and (not(self.links->select(x | x.bandwidthKbps >= 1)->size() >= 1))
